paperTitle: A Data-Oriented Serious Game for Breast Cancer Biopsy Procedures Education
centralContribution: This work presents a data-oriented serious game designed for the education of healthcare professionals, enabling interactive simulation of breast cancer biopsy procedures and decision-making based on real clinical cases and the BI-RADS radiological system. The game supports an unrestricted number of clinical cases through its data-driven architecture and includes an extensible glossary for learning and consultation.

units.title: Central Contribution
units.summary: Novel data-oriented serious game for breast cancer biopsy education.

content.description: The paper introduces a novel data-oriented serious game for healthcare professionals, simulating breast cancer biopsy procedures and related decision-making. It leverages real clinical cases and the BI-RADS system, supporting an unlimited number of cases through its architecture and including an extensible glossary.

units.whyThisUnit: This unit highlights the main innovation and purpose of the paper, serving as the core message for the exhibit.

units.title: Abstract
units.summary: Serious game addresses gap in breast cancer biopsy education for professionals.

content.description: Breast cancer is a leading cause of death among women, with early detection significantly increasing survival rates. The diagnostic process involves imaging and biopsies (PAAF, BFA, Surgical Biopsy), guided by the BI-RADS classification. Current digital educational games for oncology, particularly for healthcare professionals focusing on biopsy decision-making with features like attempts, repetitions, and glossary lookups, are scarce and limited in scope. This paper addresses this gap by developing a serious game.

units.whyThisUnit: Provides a concise overview of the problem, context, and the paper's approach, serving as an initial entry point to the research.
